literal: On the bingxu new moon of the third month, Xiao Han was made Xuanwu Army military governor; generals and officers were granted titles and rewards differing in grade.
idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the third month Xiao Han was appointed Xuanwu Army military governor; generals and officers received titles and rewards in varying degrees.

literal: On renyin day, Jin's officials from all bureaus, consorts, eunuchs, specialists, artisans, maps and registers, calendars and astronomy, stone classics, bronze mannequins, clepsydra of the Bright Hall, Music Bureau scores, palace and county records, imperial regalia, ritual objects, and armor and weapons were all sent to the Supreme Capital.
idiomatic: On renyin day Jin's bureau officials, consorts, eunuchs, specialists, artisans, maps and registers, calendars and astronomical instruments, stone classics, bronze mannequins, Bright Hall clepsydra, Music Bureau scores, palace and county records, imperial regalia, ritual objects, and armor and weapons were all sent to the Supreme Capital.

literal: Cizhou commander Liang Hui surrendered Xiang Prefecture to Han; on jiyou day Gao Tangying was ordered to attack him.
idiomatic: Cizhou commander Liang Hui surrendered Xiang Prefecture to Han; on jiyou day Gao Tangying was ordered to attack him.

literal: That summer, on the bingchen new moon of the fourth month, he departed from Bian, taking Feng Dao, Li Song, He Ning, Li Huan, Xu Taifu, Zhang Li, and others with him.
idiomatic: That summer, on the bingchen new moon of the fourth month, he set out from Bian with Feng Dao, Li Song, He Ning, Li Huan, Xu Taifu, Zhang Li, and others in attendance.

literal: Halting at Red Knoll, at night there was a sound like thunder rising from the imperial tent; a great star again fell before the banners and drums.
idiomatic: When he halted at Red Knoll, a sound like thunder rose from the imperial tent at night, and a great star again fell before the banners and drums.

literal: On yichou day, crossing the Liyang ford, he turned to his attendants and said: "On this journey I have three faults: allowing troops to plunder fodder and grain — that is the first;
idiomatic: On yichou day, after crossing the Liyang ford, he turned to his attendants and said, "On this journey I have three faults: allowing troops to plunder fodder and grain — that is the first;

literal: requisitioning private wealth from the people — that is the second;
idiomatic: requisitioning private wealth from the people — that is the second;

literal: not promptly sending the military governors back to their posts — that is the third.
idiomatic: not promptly sending the military governors back to their posts — that is the third.

literal: " The Imperial Younger Brother sent an envoy to inquire about affairs at the front; the Emperor replied: "At first with two hundred thousand troops Du Chongwei and Zhang Yanze submitted, and we took Zhen Prefecture.
idiomatic: " The Imperial Younger Brother sent an envoy to inquire about affairs at the front; the Emperor replied, "At first with two hundred thousand troops I made Du Chongwei and Zhang Yanze submit and took Zhen Prefecture.

literal: When we entered Bian, we reduced offices where staffs were at full complement and put men to posts according to their talents.
idiomatic: When we entered Bian, I reduced offices where staffs were at full complement and put men to posts according to their talents.

literal: Though the bureaus remained, the officials were ruined and decayed — like after fledglings have flown, nothing but empty nests.
idiomatic: Though the bureaus remained, the officials were ruined and decayed — like after fledglings have flown, nothing but empty nests.

literal: Long torn by turmoil, things had come to this.
idiomatic: Long torn by turmoil, things had come to this.

literal: Everywhere bandits gathered; earthworks never ceased; supplies came at the wrong times; the people could not bear the burden.
idiomatic: Everywhere bandits gathered; earthworks never ceased; supplies came at the wrong times; the people could not bear the burden.

literal: Hedong had not yet submitted; chieftains of the western route likewise banded together. Thinking day and night, the means to control them were only three: trusting the common staff, harmonizing army morale, and comforting the people.
idiomatic: Hedong had not yet submitted, and chieftains of the western route likewise banded together. Thinking day and night, the means to control them were only three: trusting the common staff, harmonizing army morale, and comforting the people.

literal: Those who have now submitted number seventy-six places in all, yielding one million nine hundred one thousand one hundred eighteen households.
idiomatic: Those who have now submitted number seventy-six places in all, yielding one million nine hundred one thousand one hundred eighteen households.

literal: But for Bian's heat and its hard soil and water to live on, we could stay only one year; peace could be achieved as easily as pointing to the palm of one's hand.
idiomatic: But for Bian's heat and its hard soil and water, we could stay only one year; peace could be achieved as easily as pointing to the palm of one's hand.

literal: Moreover Zhen Prefecture was renamed Central Capital to serve imperial tours.
idiomatic: Moreover Zhen Prefecture was renamed Central Capital to serve imperial tours.

literal: We mean to attack Hedong, but for the present await another plan.
idiomatic: We mean to attack Hedong, but for the present await another plan.

literal: Such is the general outline.
idiomatic: Such is the general outline.

literal: " On wuchen day he halted at Gaoyi; he fell ill.
idiomatic: " On wuchen day he halted at Gaoyi and fell ill.

literal: On dingchou day he died at Luancheng, aged forty-six.
idiomatic: On dingchou day he died at Luancheng, aged forty-six.

literal: That year, on the renzi new moon of the ninth month, he was buried at Phoenix Mountain; his tomb was called Huai Ling; his temple name was Taizong.
idiomatic: That year, on the renzi new moon of the ninth month, he was buried at Phoenix Mountain; his tomb was called Huai Ling, and his temple name was Taizong.

literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe, seventh month, he was posthumously titled Filial Martial Emperor.
idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe, seventh month, he was posthumously titled Filial Martial Emperor.

literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, ninth month, his posthumous title was augmented to Filial Martial, Bountiful and Cultured Emperor.
idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, ninth month, his posthumous title was augmented to Filial Martial, Bountiful and Cultured Emperor.

literal: The encomium reads: Scarcely had Taizong settled the many regions when near and far turned to his transformation.
idiomatic: The encomium reads: Scarcely had Taizong settled the many regions when near and far turned to his rule.

literal: He established the dynastic title, prepared statutes and regulations, put common government in order, reviewed names and reality, recorded prisoners, taught planting and weaving, and matched widowers and widows.
idiomatic: He established the dynastic title, prepared statutes and regulations, put common government in order, reviewed names and reality, recorded prisoners, taught planting and weaving, and matched widowers and widows.

literal: Seeking men of frank counsel, he found Gentleman Haisi and immediately promoted him to Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.
idiomatic: Seeking men of frank counsel, he found Yelü Haisi and immediately promoted him to Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.

literal: He praised Tang's Zhang Jingda for loyalty to his ruler and at last buried him with full rites.
idiomatic: He praised Tang's Zhang Jingda for loyalty to his ruler and at last buried him with full rites.

literal: He gave up pleasure excursions and heeded Sanko's plain counsel; he pitied the soldiers and issued orders for rest and recuperation.
idiomatic: He gave up pleasure excursions and heeded Sanko's plain counsel; he pitied the soldiers and issued orders for rest and recuperation.

literal: He personally campaigned against Jin, and Chonggui came bound with cords before him.
idiomatic: He personally campaigned against Jin, and Chonggui came bound with cords before him.

literal: This may be called combining majesty and virtue, with heroic strategy appearing here and there.
idiomatic: This may be called combining majesty and virtue, with heroic strategy appearing here and there.

literal: After entering Bian, there was no slightest trace of pride; there was the admonition of the "Three Faults."
idiomatic: After entering Bian, there was no slightest trace of pride; there was the admonition of the "Three Faults."

literal: The Commentary Classic speaks of the Duke of Zheng's skill in handling victory; the Documents Classic presents the Qin Oath for the power to repent of faults — Taizong surely combined both. How lofty he was!
idiomatic: The Commentary Classic speaks of the Duke of Zheng's skill in handling victory; the Documents Classic presents the Qin Oath for the power to repent of faults — Taizong surely combined both. How lofty he was!
